# Outbox events

Sources: `proto/engram/internal/events/v1/events.proto`; register N80, N115, N124, N128.

Every row of the per-shard `outbox` is one `Event` (decision D6). Events are thin: ids, hashes and small scalars, never
text or vectors. The envelope below is followed by the payload variants of its `oneof payload` and by every payload
message. Fields suffixed `_bytes` are 16-byte ids (N80); a message with `page` and `page_count` is paged and a consumer
treats a group as complete only when every page was seen.

## Messages

### DocumentVersionStarted

DocumentVersionStarted: a new document version row exists (INGESTING).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `document_id` | string |
| 2 | `version` | int64 |
| 3 | `content_hash` | string |
| 4 | `update_mode` | UpdateMode |
| 5 | `chunks_planned` | int32 |

### ChunkCommitted

ChunkCommitted: CommitChunk committed a chunk with its facts, vectors, mentions and links. Paging group key:
(document_id, version, chunk_id_bytes).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `document_id` | string |
| 2 | `version` | int64 |
| 4 | `content_hash` | string |
| 7 | `links_written` | int32 |
| 8 | `mentioned_at` | Timestamp |
| 9 | `page` | uint32 |
| 10 | `page_count` | uint32 |
| 11 | `ids_elided` | bool |
| 12 | `fact_count` | int32 |
| 13 | `entity_count` | int32 |
| 14 | `chunk_id_bytes` | bytes |
| 15 | `fact_ids_bytes` | repeated bytes |
| 16 | `entity_ids_bytes` | repeated bytes |

- `page`: Paging (N80): 0-based page and the number of pages of the group.
- `ids_elided`: True above 4,096 ids: lists empty, counts below, read by document_id.
- `fact_ids_bytes`: ≤ 256 ids across fact_ids_bytes and entity_ids_bytes per event (N80).

### DocumentDeleted

DocumentDeleted: the O(1) soft-delete marker (decision N115), emitted again when the expunge materializes and when it
purges. The `seq` of the first (PENDING) event is stored on the tombstone as `event_seq`: the expunge's purge waits
until every registered consumer cursor has passed it. No id list: consumers delete by the indexed `(namespace_id,
document_id)` query restricted to `document_version <= up_to_version`, because the same document_id may have been
retained again since (decision N133c).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `document_id` | string |
| 7 | `deleted_at` | Timestamp |
| 16 | `state` | ExpungeState |
| 17 | `up_to_version` | int64 |

- `up_to_version`: The tombstone covers every version of the document up to and including this one; versions above it
  are live content and must be kept.

### FactInvalidated

FactInvalidated: a `fact_hidden(invalidate)` marker was inserted (decision N115). When the same document holds a visible
same-content twin, the same transaction hides it and writes one event per fact (decision N145). The marker does not
depend on the fact row and outlives its purge. Re-extraction markers (`reextract`) are not events: they are inserted by
FinalizeVersion and covered by ChunksTombstoned / the version events. Observation and page versions whose segment names
the fact are hidden by the read predicate; no per-version event exists.

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `invalidated_at` | Timestamp |
| 3 | `reason` | string |
| 4 | `fact_id_bytes` | bytes |

### FactRestored

FactRestored: the `fact_hidden(invalidate)` marker was deleted.

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `fact_id_bytes` | bytes |

### ObservationUpserted

ObservationUpserted: a stage-2 consolidation write created a new observation version (decision N121). Paging group key:
(observation_id_bytes, version).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `version` | int64 |
| 4 | `effective_at` | Timestamp |
| 5 | `op_key` | string |
| 6 | `created` | bool |
| 7 | `page` | uint32 |
| 8 | `page_count` | uint32 |
| 9 | `ids_elided` | bool |
| 10 | `source_count` | int32 |
| 11 | `observation_id_bytes` | bytes |
| 12 | `source_fact_ids_bytes` | repeated bytes |
| 13 | `root_version` | int64 |

- `ids_elided`: Above 4,096 sources: list empty, read the version's sources by observation_id.
- `source_fact_ids_bytes`: ≤ 256 ids per event (N80).
- `root_version`: The version's root_version (decision N117): equal to `version` for a root rebuild.

### ObservationsMarkedStale

ObservationsMarkedStale: evidence changed under these observations (`stale_write` from a replace-tombstone or restore:
still visible; `stale_delete` from an expunge materialize or an invalidate: a rebuild is nudged, and versions whose
segment names the victim are already hidden by the read predicate). Paging group key: (cause_fact_id_bytes, document_id
of the cause when known).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | `page` | uint32 |
| 4 | `page_count` | uint32 |
| 5 | `ids_elided` | bool |
| 6 | `observation_count` | int32 |
| 7 | `observation_ids_bytes` | repeated bytes |
| 8 | `cause_fact_id_bytes` | bytes |

### RestoreMarker

RestoreMarker: the shard was restored from backup to `restored_to` or promoted after a failover; the epoch of every
namespace it hosts was bumped and the delete intents were replayed (decisions N122, N123). Consumers (external index,
Kafka) reconcile from this point.

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `shard_id` | int32 |
| 2 | `restored_to` | Timestamp |
| 3 | `epoch_bump` | bool |

### NamespaceDeleted

NamespaceDeleted: DeleteNamespace or DeleteTenant froze the namespace (`freeze_delete`) after the intent object was
durable (decision N122). The delete is effective; an external index drops its namespace index.

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `deleted_at` | Timestamp |
| 2 | `tenant_delete` | bool |

- `tenant_delete`: True when the delete came from DeleteTenant.

### ChunksTombstoned

ChunksTombstoned: FinalizeVersion inserted chunk_tombstones (decision N115). The facts of those chunks are hidden from
the fact and chunk arms by the read predicate; derived versions stay visible (a replace is a write, decision N135), and
the evidence rows are kept. Paging group key: (document_id, version, tombstoned_at).

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `document_id` | string |
| 2 | `version` | int64 |
| 3 | `chunk_ids` | repeated bytes |
| 4 | `reason` | string |
| 5 | `tombstoned_at` | Timestamp |
| 6 | `page` | uint32 |
| 7 | `page_count` | uint32 |
| 8 | `ids_elided` | bool |
| 9 | `chunk_count` | int32 |

- `version`: Version whose finalisation tombstoned them.
- `chunk_ids`: ≤ 256 ids per event.
- `reason`: 'replace' or 'reextract'.

### DocumentTagsUpdated

DocumentTagsUpdated: UpdateDocumentTags changed the filter tags of a document (decision N157, review A-13). A tag change
creates no document version, so this event and the document's `tag_generation` are how outbox consumers and the export
delta learn about it. Written in the same transaction as the `documents` row update and the `tag_counts` change.

| No. | Field | Type |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `document_id` | string |
| 2 | `tag_generation` | int64 |
| 3 | `version` | int64 |
| 4 | `tags_added` | int32 |
| 5 | `tags_removed` | int32 |

- `tag_generation`: The document's tag_generation after the change.
- `version`: The document's current_version when the tags changed.
- `tags_added`: How many tags the call added and removed (the tags are on the row).
